facts.claim: No acceptance criterion in revision 1 covered constructing the scanner with a classifier or running the collapse in the app; TASK-613's criterion is about the store API, which was built and audited as written.
TASK-611, TASK-612 and TASK-613 are verified and their evidence states the unwired limitation explicitly, so no audited claim is contradicted by adding the wiring task.

findings.statement: OUTCOME-610 claims scans finish on a real-sized scope, but with no task owning the wiring that claim would be false on an installed machine while the rung passed.
findings.resolution: TASK-615 added to rung 1, validation-required by GATE-619.

invariants: No existing node, edge, criterion or verified result is changed or removed.
The new task is validation-required by its rung's gate, so the rung cannot pass without it.
Verified work on TASK-611, TASK-612 and TASK-613 is preserved; the replan only adds.
summary: Adds TASK-615 so the object model actually takes effect in the running app, closing a gap between what rung 1 claims and what an installed machine would do.
limitations: The convergence run uses a captured copy of an installed store; the live database is never opened.
Sizing, ranking and presentation remain rung 2.
